records.name: Zamboanga Peninsula
records.summary:
This division was covered by the dedicated country dossier, which identified no deviation from the national position material enough to score separately (±0.02); it is therefore assessed at the national score.

Caveat from the country dossier: this region adjoins the autonomous Bangsamoro area, where Shari'ah court jurisdiction operates over Muslim personal status and criminal matters; no documentation of trans-related divergence was located for this region itself - absence of evidence, not evidence of absence.
